title: Troves can be sorted incorrectly due to interest accrual
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The `SortedTroves` contract is expected to keep troves sorted by descending nominal ICR. This is a crucial invariant for the system, as it determines the order in which troves are liquidated and redeemed. However, the interest accrual mechanism can cause troves to be sorted incorrectly.
